data.magnitude_scaling: abs(stft)/sqrt(2048), physical units; flow state uses log1p(magnitude/1e-4)
data.training_recipe: all accepted #172 basic and expanded pairs; basic labels are expanded with canonical default values before use
data.validation_recipe: frozen #173 held-out expanded pairs; exact 2048-point spectral masks and recipe hashes verified

evaluation.envelope: Parseval RMS derived from stereo 2048 STFT; onset <50ms, decay 50–250ms, sustain after 250ms, release first 300ms after MIDI note-off
evaluation.octave: mean absolute dB error in ten fixed one-octave band powers from 21.5 Hz to Nyquist on all non-silent valid frames; report a separate MIDI-centered five-band absolute dB diagnostic on supported monophonic frames
evaluation.uncertainty: 10,000 paired patch-root bootstrap replicates; MIDI performances not resampled

plan.question: Does conditional flow matching improve known-patch known-MIDI forward audio prediction, particularly monophonic octave energy and MIDI-aligned envelope fidelity?

training.direct_loss: single-resolution spectral convergence plus log-magnitude L1, equal weights
training.flow_loss: MSE velocity in log1p magnitude space; z(t)=(1-t)e+t*x; velocity is predicted clean endpoint minus full-dimensional initial noise; t shared per clip; e~N(0,I)
training.starting_weights: random initialization; no pretrained or #173 checkpoints loaded
